caption: The drawing depicts a side view of a cow standing on a rectangular base. The body of the cow is brown with various patches of darker and lighter brown, as well as greenish and bluish spots that suggest areas of oxidation or weathering. The cow’s head is angled forward and features two short, white-tipped horns, a visible eye, and a prominent snout. There is a distinct metal or riveted plate detail across the upper back and shoulder area, as well as along the back, creating the appearance of seams or hinges. The cow’s underside and the area near the tail are lighter in color, showing a textured, off-white pattern. The legs are brown with alternating lighter bands and end in dark hooves. The rectangular base beneath the cow is mottled green and brown, resembling an aged or weathered metal surface. The background is plain and uncolored, allowing the figure of the cow and its base to stand out clearly.
title: Cow Weather Vane
